failures.b: are we in profit or loss

scope_statement: A nearest-centroid router over static embeddings is built from the 17-case TUNED corpus and scored on the 21-case HELDOUT corpus it has never seen, beside the deterministic pattern layer on the same corpora. Out-of-scope recall is measured against 14 ordinary questions from other domains; paraphrase invariance follows CheckList's INV design. NOT CLAIMED: that 21 held-out cases and 14 probes are a benchmark — they are small, they are ours, and a wider corpus would move these numbers. NOT CLAIMED: that this matches a hosted model; it matches a regex layer, which is what the deployed demo actually ships.
